blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecution panel tried to ask the Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI) whether it maintains foreign accounts under Vice President Sara Duterte, but the Senate Impeachment Court blocked the inquiry as it is outside the subpoena’s scope. During Wednesday’s resumption of Duterte’s impeachment trial, private prosecutor James Bryan Ibrahim Alih asked BPI Division Head Marwin Galvez whether Duterte and her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, have foreign accounts with the bank. However, Presiding Officer and Senator-judge Francis Escudero sustained the objection from respondent’s counsel, Michael Poa. “Sustained, not part of the subpoena issued by this court and covered […]...
